item.description: Cost of living and AI outrank climate change and war as top concerns for future, but support for multiculturalism remains strong Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast The vast majority of Australians support immigration and multiculturalism despite more feeling poorer – and increasingly pessimistic and distrustful of government, the annual Scanlon report on social cohesion has revealed. item.title: H-1B, immigration and Trump: Why Indian-American voters turned away from Republicans
item.description: With Democrats gaining Congressional control, Indian-Americans are grappling with uncertainty regarding immigration rules and job opportunities. Heightened fears about H-1B visa restrictions and deportation have taken center stage. In addition, increasing discrimination and the prevailing political climate are altering feelings of identity among the community. New survey data reveals a trend towards favoring Democratic candidates, indicating that the outcomes of the midterms might significantly influence the Indian-American experience. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Research reveals accelerating sea-level rise around Ireland
item.description: A new study led by the ICARUS Climate Research Center at Maynooth University in Ireland has reconstructed a century of Irish sea-level change, revealing a stark acceleration in sea-level rise. The research, titled "A Century of Sea-Level Change in Ireland (1925–2024)" and published in Ocean Science, combines tide-gauge records from six locations, including newly digitized historical records from Cork, Tarbert and Galway. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Funding to help poorer countries cope with climate crisis has stalled, says UN
item.description: Report reveals financial support promised by rich nations for adaptation measures is well behind the pace that is needed Flows of money to help poor countries cope with the climate crisis have been flat or falling since 2022 , despite growing impacts from extreme weather and warnings from scientists that global heating may be accelerating . A new UN report has revealed that financial support for adaptation – which includes measures such as stronger infrastructure, early warning systems, flood protection and drought-resilient irrigation – is woefully short of what is needed and far behind even… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: El régimen cubano libera a la corresponsal de ABC, Camila Acosta, tras varias horas detenida
item.description: La corresponsal de ABC en la Habana, Camila Acosta, ha sido liberada después de pasar una noche arrestada en los calabozos del régimen. Según confirmó la periodista a este periódico a través de un mensaje de audio, las autoridades le requirieron su teléfono móvil para mantenerla totalmente incomunicada. Tras su puesta en libertad, Acosta explicó que la detención estuvo relacionada con un vídeo que grabó el pasado 28 de octubre, en el que un hombre vestido de civil, identificado por ella como agente de la Seguridad del Estado, le impedía salir de su vivienda.
